title: State and Local Predatory Towing Enforcement Act
short_title: State and Local Predatory Towing Enforcement Act

actions.text: Sponsor introductory remarks on measure. (CR E916)
Referred to the House Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure.
Referred to the Subcommittee on Highways and Transit.

latest_action.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on Highways and Transit.

summaries.text:
State and Local Predatory Towing Enforcement Act - Waives federal pre-emption to allow states to regulate tow truck operations performed without the prior consent or authorization of the owner or operator of the towed motor vehicle.
 (Currently, states are allowed to regulate only the price of for-hire motor vehicle transportation by a tow truck, if such transportation is performed without the prior consent or authorization of the owner or operator of the motor vehicle.)
